note: D1 sun_flare surge {cost: -1, radius: 1}: the growth tile pays for both halves of the surge at once - the flare costs 1 instead of 2 AND reaches radius 3, so the smokestack three tiles away is hit. The second cast is the proof of the discount: 3 charge minus a discounted 1 leaves 2, exactly the full price of the unsurged repeat (which reaches only radius 2 and leaves that same smokestack untouched); had the first cast cost 2 the second would have been illegal
